label: DAY 32
title: AI plays my bus game. The bot that gave up on the bus got passed 5 times.

lines.text: Bus is late. I'll just walk.
My bot did that after 10 ticks.
The bus came 4 ticks later. Five buses passed it.

scenes.title: My game: Bus or Walk
lines: Buses come every 30 ticks on average. At random.
So my waiting bot waited 28, not 15.

lines.text: So do I wait or walk?
Neither. Walk to the next stop, and look back.
Giving up after 10 was second worst.
But then I miss the bus.
It only walks when no bus is close. The bus still catches it.
This morning no bus came. Waiting took 238.

lines: Faster in 1,403 of 10,000 mornings. Slower in zero.
Do you wait or walk? Tell me below.

thumbnail.headline: Gave up on the bus. It came 4 ticks later.
